ca-bong-song-tra-kho-tieu-quang-ngai.name: Quang Ngai Tra River Goby Braised with Pepper
aliases: Tra River goby braised with pepper
ca-bong-song-tra-kho-tieu-quang-ngai.serving_basis: One small pot of fish served with steamed rice for four.
ca-bong-song-tra-kho-tieu-quang-ngai.description: Small gobies simmer gently with fish sauce, black pepper and a little chili until firm and glazed. Bếp Việt edits this home-style version for a family meal, keeping the Tra River specialty's peppery aroma and balanced savory-sweet finish.
ca-bong-song-tra-kho-tieu-quang-ngai.finished_dish: Whole gobies are firm and peppery, coated in a light glossy sauce fragrant with shallot.
ca-bong-song-tra-kho-tieu-quang-ngai.excerpt: Whole gobies are firm and peppery, coated in a light glossy sauce fragrant with shallot.
ca-bong-song-tra-kho-tieu-quang-ngai.serving: Serve hot with steamed rice and boiled greens; spoon a little braising sauce over the rice.
tips: Choose fresh small gobies; rinse gently and drain well so they stay intact.
Season with fish sauce early, then taste near the end because the sauce will reduce.
Braise over low heat and gently shake the pot instead of stirring.
ca-bong-song-tra-kho-tieu-quang-ngai.tip: Choose fresh small gobies; rinse gently and drain well so they stay intact.
ca-bong-song-tra-kho-tieu-quang-ngai.image_alt: A rustic pot of glossy Tra River goby braised with black pepper, red chili and scallion.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: Add enough to nearly cover fish.

preparation_steps.instruction: Gently rinse fish until water runs clear, remove gills and entrails if present, then drain well.
Marinate fish with fish sauce, sugar, caramel and half the pepper for 10 minutes.
Peel and mince shallots; prepare chili and a heavy-bottomed pot.

cooking_steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté shallot until fragrant. Arrange fish and marinade in the pot, then add water and chili.
Bring to a gentle simmer, skim if needed, lower heat and braise 20–25 minutes, gently shaking the pot occasionally.
When sauce is lightly glossy and fish firm, taste, add remaining pepper and turn off heat.

ca-bong-song-tra-kho-tieu-quang-ngai.time_note: Smaller fish absorb seasoning quickly; avoid reducing the sauce until dry so the fish stays moist.

chao-hau-vung-tau.name: Vung Tau Oyster Porridge
province: TP. Hồ Chí Minh (Bà Rịa - Vũng Tàu cũ)
chao-hau-vung-tau.description: Rice simmers into lightly creamy porridge; oysters are briefly sautéed and added near the end to preserve their briny sweetness. Fried shallot, scallion, cilantro and pepper make a warming bowl; Bếp Việt edits this for home cooking.
chao-hau-vung-tau.finished_dish: Soft rice grains in a lightly thickened broth, with plump oysters and fragrant pepper and herbs.
chao-hau-vung-tau.excerpt: Soft rice grains in a lightly thickened broth, with plump oysters and fragrant pepper and herbs.
chao-hau-vung-tau.serving: Ladle into bowls and finish with fried shallot, scallion, cilantro and pepper; thinly sliced banana blossom is optional.
tips: Use cleaned oysters kept properly chilled, and cook through.
Sauté oysters just until firm and add near the end to avoid a rubbery texture.
Add hot water if porridge thickens, and stir the bottom regularly.
chao-hau-vung-tau.tip: Use cleaned oysters kept properly chilled, and cook through.
chao-hau-vung-tau.image_alt: A lightly creamy oyster porridge topped with oysters, fried shallot, scallion and pepper.

ingredients.name: Shucked oysters
ingredients.notes: Clean, drain and keep chilled until cooking.

ingredients.name: Shallots
ingredients.notes: Mince some for oysters; fry the rest golden.

preparation_steps.instruction: Rinse the rice, soak 15 minutes, then drain.
Rinse oysters gently, remove shell fragments and drain; keep chilled during prep.
Halve large mushrooms; mince shallot and slice ginger, scallions and cilantro.

cooking_steps.instruction: Add both rice types and water. Boil, lower heat, leave lid ajar and simmer 30–35 minutes until tender, stirring periodically.
Heat oil and sauté some shallot and ginger. Cook mushrooms 2 minutes, then add oysters and toss until just firm.
Stir oysters into porridge, season and cook 3–5 minutes until done. Turn off heat and garnish with scallion, cilantro, pepper and fried shallot.

chao-hau-vung-tau.time_note: Simmering time varies by rice; add oysters near the end and cook through without overcooking.

mit-non-kho-nam-chay.name: Vegetarian Braised Young Jackfruit with Straw Mushrooms
aliases: Young jackfruit braised with mushrooms and tofu
mit-non-kho-nam-chay.serving_basis: One shared braise for a four-person meal.
mit-non-kho-nam-chay.description: Tender young jackfruit is braised with straw mushrooms and tofu in soy, lemongrass and vegetarian fish-sauce broth. Bếp Việt edits this home version so the sauce reduces lightly while ingredients keep their shape.
mit-non-kho-nam-chay.finished_dish: Tender jackfruit with sweet mushrooms and tofu in a lightly reduced lemongrass sauce.
mit-non-kho-nam-chay.excerpt: Tender jackfruit with sweet mushrooms and tofu in a lightly reduced lemongrass sauce.
mit-non-kho-nam-chay.serving: Serve with rice and cilantro or leek greens. Check seasonings are plant-based for a fully vegan meal.
tips: If fresh jackfruit is sticky with latex, boil it for 5 minutes and drain before pan-frying.
Briefly pan-frying jackfruit and tofu helps the pieces hold their shape.
Use vegetarian fish sauce; do not use regular fish sauce for a vegetarian meal.
mit-non-kho-nam-chay.tip: If fresh jackfruit is sticky with latex, boil it for 5 minutes and drain before pan-frying.
mit-non-kho-nam-chay.image_alt: Young jackfruit with straw mushrooms and tofu in glossy sauce, finished with chili and herbs.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a variety suited to taste.

preparation_steps.instruction: Cut jackfruit into bite-size pieces. If sticky, parboil 5 minutes, rinse and drain.
Pat tofu dry and cube; clean the mushrooms.
Mince lemongrass and leek white; slice the leek greens and chili.

cooking_steps.instruction: Pan-fry jackfruit in a little oil until lightly golden; remove. Fry tofu until its surfaces set.
Sauté lemongrass and leek in annatto oil. Cook mushrooms until just tender, then add jackfruit, water, soy, vegetarian fish sauce and sugar.
Bring to a gentle boil, lower heat and braise 15–20 minutes. Add tofu halfway; taste, add leek greens and chili, and turn off heat when sauce thickens lightly.

mit-non-kho-nam-chay.time_note: Fresh and pre-cooked jackfruit vary in tenderness; adjust timing so pieces do not break apart.

cha-ca-la-vong-ha-noi.name: Hanoi Cha Ca La Vong
cha-ca-la-vong-ha-noi.serving_basis: Four portions served with vermicelli, herbs and peanuts.
cha-ca-la-vong-ha-noi.description: Catfish is marinated with galangal, turmeric and fermented rice, then cooked in two stages so it browns outside and stays tender inside; dill and scallion are tossed in just before serving. Bếp Việt adapts the home method for an oven or air fryer before a final pan toss.
cha-ca-la-vong-ha-noi.finished_dish: Golden turmeric fish fragrant with galangal and fermented rice, tossed with dill and scallion and served with vermicelli, peanuts and seasoned shrimp paste.
cha-ca-la-vong-ha-noi.excerpt: Golden turmeric fish fragrant with galangal and fermented rice, tossed with dill and scallion and served with vermicelli, peanuts and seasoned shrimp paste.
cha-ca-la-vong-ha-noi.serving: Bring the pan to the table and serve with vermicelli, peanuts, herbs and lime-chili shrimp paste.
tips: In an air fryer or oven, arrange fish in one layer and cook just until done; do not dry it out.
Fermented rice varies in acidity, so taste the marinade before adding lime or vinegar.
Add dill and scallion at the end so they wilt but keep their color.
cha-ca-la-vong-ha-noi.tip: In an air fryer or oven, arrange fish in one layer and cook just until done; do not dry it out.
cha-ca-la-vong-ha-noi.image_alt: Golden Hanoi cha ca with dill, scallion, roasted peanuts and fresh vermicelli.

ingredients.name: Catfish fillet
ingredients.notes: Skin on or off, cut thick.

preparation_steps.instruction: Pat catfish dry, check for pin bones and cut into serving pieces.
Mix galangal, turmeric, fermented rice, shrimp paste, fish sauce and sugar. Coat fish, cover and marinate refrigerated for 45–60 minutes.
Wash dill, scallions and herbs and cut into lengths. Mix shrimp paste with lime and chili for serving.

cooking_steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 220°C or prepare the air fryer. Arrange fish in one layer, brush with oil and cook 8–12 minutes, turning once, until just done and lightly golden.
Heat remaining oil in a pan. Briefly sear each side if fish needs more color.
Add dill and scallion and toss 30–60 seconds until just wilted. Serve immediately with vermicelli, peanuts, herbs and seasoned shrimp paste.

cha-ca-la-vong-ha-noi.time_note: Keep fish chilled while marinating; cooking time depends on thickness and appliance.

suggested_pairings: Fresh herbs and lime shrimp paste

banh-thuan-quang-nam.name: Quang Nam Banh Thuan Flower Cakes
banh-thuan-quang-nam.serving_basis: About 12 small cakes, depending on mold size.
banh-thuan-quang-nam.description: Quang Nam banh thuan has flower-like petals and fragrant egg aroma, traditionally made for Tet, family rites and guests. Bếp Việt edits a small home batch with arrowroot starch, eggs and sugar baked in a small mold; texture varies with starch and mold.
banh-thuan-quang-nam.finished_dish: Pale golden cakes bloom into petals, smell of egg and have a lightly dry exterior with an airy crumb.
banh-thuan-quang-nam.excerpt: Pale golden cakes bloom into petals, smell of egg and have a lightly dry exterior with an airy crumb.
banh-thuan-quang-nam.serving: Cool on a rack and serve with hot tea; store airtight once completely cool.
tips: Sift arrowroot starch and beat eggs thoroughly for a smooth batter.
Preheat mold and brush lightly with oil so petals form cleanly.
When using an oven instead of the traditional mold, test a small batch because mold and heat affect rise.
banh-thuan-quang-nam.tip: Sift arrowroot starch and beat eggs thoroughly for a smooth batter.
banh-thuan-quang-nam.image_alt: A stack of golden flower-shaped banh thuan cakes with airy centers.

preparation_steps.instruction: Sift arrowroot starch, tapioca starch and salt; preheat oven to 170°C for an oven-safe mold.
Beat eggs and sugar until pale and thick; add vanilla.
Sift starch into eggs in batches, fold until smooth and rest for 10–15 minutes.

cooking_steps.instruction: Preheat a banh thuan mold or small muffin pan. Brush lightly with oil and fill each cavity about two-thirds full.
For cast-iron or copper molds, cover and bake per instructions until golden and a tester comes clean. In an oven pan, bake 12–16 minutes and check early.
Cool on a rack. For a drier crust, dry gently at 90°C for about 10 minutes, then cool completely.

banh-thuan-quang-nam.time_note: This small-batch home method is an adaptation; traditional molds and starch types can produce different textures.
